limits: One observation per board/arm, shared co-runners and memory admission; no statistical significance estimate.
Clean means the existing benchmark relaxed DRC. No final-board output geometry is archived for a complete independent manufacturing audit.
All routing/HD timings here are within this job. Stage clocks are not an exact decomposition of whole-routing time.
RSS is full-process peak, not isolated solver memory. Failure phase is reported to scope whether HD ever ran; it is not the measured phase of the peak.
Ordinary CI is a separate source/base merge scope. Final365 CI retains Bug10792 numerical errors and seven SVG failures; MIDI numerical/preload guards pass with only the SVG failing.

analysisCalibration.scope: Analysis logic calibration only; no prior elapsed observations are pooled with this report.

verdicts.quality: Previous full source 8115 remains the quality leader: 35 clean versus final365 34 and baseline33. Final365 retains new clean dataset24 samples2/11 but loses baseline/old-full-clean dataset18 sample15 with174 DRC errors. The conservative junction fix does not restore that board.
verdicts.optimization: No substantial final-versus-old-full routing improvement: common-clean routing -0.298747% on dataset18 (n15 excludes lost sample15), +0.184994% on dataset24 (n19). StrictHD -0.383083%/+1.314028%. Fixed-corpus comparison score is3.274407% worse overall than old-full; this is not runner wall time.
verdicts.correctness: MIDI numerical repair and local node/junction improvements remain useful, but final365 ordinary CI still fails Bug107 with92 DRC errors and seven SVG expectations. Do not promote as regression-free.
verdicts.memory: Baseline global dataset24 RSS peak8.762920GiB is sample24 EDGE beforeHD; old6.856319/final6.450397GiB are sample1 HD timeouts. Unmatched full-process maxima do not establish isolated HD memory optimization.
verdicts.work: All37 completed-HD iteration counts agree. Exact work parity does not follow: priorityCompletedWorkUnits differs on dataset18 samples13/16 and dataset24 sample11 (34 known pairs/37); physical projection work also intentionally differs.

publicationScope.transformation: Compact metadata projection only; original independent review is unchanged. Per-board diagnostic/phase/hash enumerations and raw-record digest dictionary are omitted here, not zero-filled. All six core contrast summaries and official report parity are retained. Full original renderer data remain in the final report archive.
